compact_selection: Reuse archived Task51 development minima perseed, no52 selection or training. L10/T16 failed old strict gates and remains exploratory. No readout51j applied to10latent coordinates: its18physical-gate contract is different.
readout_selection: Use archived51j final SGD weights, ordinal pairing of three readout seeds61/73/89 with P/compact seeds17/29/43. Only full18physical-gate controls receive this readout.
solver: Single compartment, analytic semi-implicit voltage and exponential calcium, fixed dt0.1. At each left endpoint update ionic state using oldV/oldCa, compute conductance/current with updated state and oldV, then updateV/Ca. This matches the task50/51 voltage-driven gate convention; not a new nativeNEURON validation. Canonical64 is the declared discrete reference. Original current and compartment thresholds copied verbatim from task46.
controls: canonical64 duplicate self-reference, canonical32 floor, full-state P and learned readout controls; compact imposedV/Ca separates ionic error from feedback. Oracle-family currents use canonical trajectory conductances and are never selectable. Reset latent at100ms tests memory causally. Block and reversal deltas paired with identical injections.
metrics: All channels and cases at100/500/1000ms: original amplitude/charge and original timing plus existing multi-event diagnostic; voltage/Ca RMSE, physical/finite limits. ImposedV/Ca voltage not treated as autonomous success. Store all traces, intervention deltas and family attributions. No averaging waives failed cases.

cost.scope: Matched three-seed one-step eager runtime by model; logical10state vs padded18temporary reported. No whole-neuron acceleration claim.

limitations: No new native reference, synapses or axial coupling. Compact memory remains unqualified; 51j only validated static readout. Passing discrete reference tests cannot promote full-neuron equivalence. No threshold changes, no return to51subtasks.
